description:
Lightweight Java toolkit for GPS track processing: Douglas-Peucker,
        Visvalingam-Whyatt and LTTB simplification, Kalman / RTS smoothing,
        WGS84/GCJ02/BD09 coordinate transform, KML/GPX parsing, encoded
        polyline codec, trajectory similarity (Frechet/Hausdorff/DTW),
        geohash and stay point detection.
